origin.description: Install the dependencies of a local package when they are missing or selected for upgrade.
origin.usage: install_deps(pkgdir = ".", dependencies = NA, repos = getOption("repos"), type = getOption("pkgType"), upgrade = c("default", "ask", "always", "never"), quiet = FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: pkgdir
arguments.text: Directory of the package whose DESCRIPTION is read.

arguments.name: dependencies
arguments.text: Which dependency fields to consider. FALSE selects none.

arguments.name: upgrade
arguments.text: never installs only a dependency that is not installed.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: dependencies = FALSE builds an empty dependency set, so nothing is installed. The return value is invisible NULL.
origin.example: install_deps(pkg, dependencies = FALSE, upgrade = "never", quiet = TRUE, lib = lib)

translation.description: Install the dependencies of a local package when they are missing or selected for upgrade.
translation.usage: install_deps(pkgdir='.', dependencies=NA, repos=None, type=None, upgrade='default', quiet=False, lib=None)

arguments.text: Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: FALSE skips installation. The library is left empty. The return value is None.
